title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing: Credit Score and Amount Limits
content:
Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing approves each plan only within that plan's credit score and financed amount limits, and within limits that apply across a customer's whole financing portfolio. The figures are set out below by plan.

## Limits by plan

| | Same-As-Cash 12 | Same-As-Cash 18 | Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Fixed-Rate 60 | Fixed-Rate 120 | Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest credit score accepted at application | 700 | 720 | 740 | 680 | 660 | 640 |
| Smallest amount financed (USD) | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 7500.00 |
| Largest amount financed (USD) | 25000.00 | 35000.00 | 40000.00 | 55000.00 | 75000.00 | 75000.00 |
| Most financed across all open accounts together (USD) | 85000.00 | 85000.00 | 85000.00 | 85000.00 | 85000.00 | 85000.00 |
| Approval validity (calendar days after the approval date) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

## Limit common to every plan

| Limit | All six plans |
|---|---|
| Most that may be financed on one contract | The contract price less the contract's required booking deposit |

## Points of reading

- The credit score is the applicant's score at application, compared with the lowest score the plan accepts.
- The smallest and largest amounts bound the amount financed on the plan; the combined figure of 85000.00 bounds the total financed across the customer's open accounts, whichever plans they are on.
- The approval validity is a number of calendar days counted after the approval date within which the loan must fund.

## Hypothetical comparison

A hypothetical applicant with a score of 700 meets the lowest accepted score of Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 (700), Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60 (680), Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 (660) and Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 (640), and falls short of Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18 (720) and Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 (740). The score is an illustration only.
